FINDING (medium, documentation): Parent roadmap is not updated as a completed V2 close-out; D013 says F003 is still “pending audit signoff” and promises a future follow-up D-entry, while F003 acceptance requires the parent roadmap update after V2 completion. Evidence: `features.json` still has F003 `passes:false`, and parent roadmap D013 says “V2 is complete pending F003 operator sign-off.” Recommendation: after F003 signoff, flip F003 close-out metadata and add/amend the parent roadmap D-entry to record V2 as actually complete, not pending.

FINDING (low, documentation): Child plan decision D003 still claims `--no-evidence` lets the operator skip evidence writes, but the CLI no longer exposes that option and tests assert it does not exist. Evidence: `plans/.../decisions.jsonl:3` mentions `--no-evidence`; `capabilities_setup.py` only defines `--evidence-dir`; test `test_cli_has_no_no_evidence_bypass_for_governed_setup_runs` asserts absence. Recommendation: amend D003 to match the implemented no-bypass behavior.
